review_description: Low quality Inverter ): trusting him as a business. Little did we know the inverter was breaking down, resulting in costing us more money.They never showed any support after they were paid!. Unbelievable!Installed a new Inverter with a new company already showing 6kW at 10am...The rubbish Eco vibe sold us never showed anything like this.If your looking for solar i suggest you go elsewhere.

Easy to deal with - no pressure selling. Happy to explain system with different configurations over & over again.Another recommended seller we were dealing with was quite informative, but turned out to represent 3 different solar companies, which put us off. So we went with Ecovibe.

The size of the system is 2.34kw.We asked Eco Vibe for names of previous customers and they provided those  to assist in our decision.Energex still has to connect our system to the grid in order for us to receive financial benefit. We  completed and returned the forms just last week.
